“A flat-topped mesa about 250 m high with steep sides”

Not applied:
    smooth  R10: smooth appears twice on the same region; combine them into one
Preview (worked out by the app on a copy of the region; nothing has changed):
    Heights in the region (metres above sea): lowest 1101 m to 1101 m, mean 2323 m to 2323 m, highest 5149 m to 4549 m.

    2 cells would have moved more than 600 m, so they are held to 600 m of change.
